parameter_semantics.meaning: Amount of gain in the preamp section. On amps without MASTER (Plexi, JTM45, Bass 50, Gojira CLN, Tim Henson Crunch) it is the amp's only volume and also drives the power amp.
Amount of volume in the preamp section. On Fender, Vox and JC style models it replaces GAIN and MASTER: one knob for whole-amp level and breakup.
parameter_semantics.brighter_or_more_direction: higher = louder into the power amp, more breakup

parameter_semantics.meaning: Amount of power amp gain; highly interactive with all other amp parameters; the lower it is, the less effect the other controls have. It is modelled power-amp drive, not a clean level. Default 3 on 66 models, 5 on 25.
parameter_semantics.brighter_or_more_direction: higher = more power-amp drive and compression (reported darker on Recto-type models)

parameter_semantics.meaning: Overall volume of the amp block, applied after the model. Range -60..+12 dB, default 0.0 dB, 0 dB at normalized 0.5 (skew 3.8018).
The amp's tonestack (interactive, model specific), not a generic EQ.
Boosts the upper midrange and treble frequencies.
Boosts the lower midrange and bass frequencies. DEEP is the Diezel name for the same kind of control.
Boosts the bass frequencies.
The treble is further enhanced with this switch. Freeman 100 Clean has three steps [Normal, Bright 1, Bright 2]; Dumbbell ODS uses [Off, Boost].

parameter_semantics.category_or_model: UK C30 TopBoost / UK C15 TopBoost
parameter_semantics.meaning: Two-step switch with step names [HOT, COOL]; default value 1 = COOL.
Two-step switch with step names [ON, OFF]; default value 1 = OFF.
Power tube type [6L6, EL34]; Squid default 6L6, Rabea default EL34. Changing it causes a brief mute.

parameter_semantics.category_or_model: Victor Squid Ch2, Petrucci Rhythm, Rabea Lead, Freeman BOD
parameter_semantics.meaning: Continuous 0-10 control; by its name a low-end tightening ahead of the gain stages.
Real BE-100: fattens the tone, suited to single coils. QC step order is unlabelled.
parameter_semantics.confidence: official for the real amp only

parameter_semantics.meaning: Real BE-100: adds gain, compression and saturation.
parameter_semantics.confidence: official for the real amp only

parameter_semantics.meaning: Real BE-100: alternate custom voicing of the BE/HBE channel (described elsewhere as a treble boost at the input or a mid scoop).
parameter_semantics.confidence: official for the real amp only; QC behaviour unverified

parameter_semantics.meaning: Real BE-100: left slightly darker with more mids, right slightly brighter with bigger bass.
parameter_semantics.confidence: official for the real amp only

parameter_semantics.meaning: Step names differ per amp: Clean [Normal, Thicker], Rhythm [Low, High], Lead [Off, On].
Voicing switch with steps [-, +].
parameter_semantics.brighter_or_more_direction: + = heavier voicing (per the Diezel description quoted on the community wiki)

parameter_semantics.meaning: Channel selector [Normal, Vibrato, Vibrato Bright Off]; INPUT is [Low, High]. MODE causes a brief mute.
Rotary [Normal, Thick, Thicker].
Tooltip: 'Adjust the gain of the Overdrive Channel.'
Tooltip: two global EQ voicings. Rock: mid-forward and aggressive. Jazz: smoother and more scooped. Steps [Jazz, Rock], default Rock. Brief mute on change.

parameter_semantics.parameter: GAIN NORMAL / MASTER NORMAL / GAIN OD / MASTER OD
parameter_semantics.meaning: Knobs run 0-11. The NORMAL pair is active when CHANNEL = Normal, the OD pair when CHANNEL = OD; CRUNCH [Clean, Crunch] belongs to the Normal channel.
The amp's master volume; GAIN I and GAIN II are the gain controls; INPUT [LOW, HIGH]; PULL GAIN [OFF, ON].

parameter_semantics.parameter: INPUT GAIN / LEAD MASTER / OUTPUT MASTER
parameter_semantics.meaning: Three cascaded level stages of the Silver Jubilee before the block OUTPUT trim.
Five-band graphic EQ, each 0-10, alongside GAIN PULL, SHRED and PRES PULL switches.
Where the microphone is, from the center of the cone to the edge of the cone. Range 0-10, default 4.0. Disabled with an external IR.
parameter_semantics.brighter_or_more_direction: 0 = centre = brighter (inference; the numeric direction is not documented)

parameter_semantics.meaning: Distance of the mic between close to the cab and far towards the room. Range 0-10, default 0.0. Disabled with an external IR.

parameter_semantics.category_or_model: Cab (plugin: Plini, Petrucci, Gojira, SLO-100, Rabea, Misha, Tim Henson, Parallax)
parameter_semantics.meaning: Same meaning as native cabs but declared on a 0-1 range (Plini default 0.5/0.0, Petrucci 0.3/0.0).
String naming the factory mic or loaded IR of one of the two slots, format '<prefix>_<cab>_<mic>'. Per-scene values are possible.
parameter_semantics.confidence: firmware; per-scene from one forum post and project notes

parameter_semantics.meaning: Phase (polarity) invert of that slot.
Block-level high-pass 20-500 Hz (20 = OFF) and low-pass 500-20000 Hz (20000 = OFF), added in CorOS 2.1.0.
parameter_semantics.brighter_or_more_direction: lower LPF = darker; higher HPF = thinner

parameter_semantics.meaning: Per-slot switch, default on. Function undocumented.
Slot level and pan (0-10, 5 = centre); OUTPUT VOLUME -96..+12 dB is the block output.

parameter_semantics.parameter: ROOM SIZE / ROOM L LEVEL / ROOM R LEVEL
parameter_semantics.meaning: Room mic section: size 0-2, levels -40..+6 dB, default -14 dB.

parameter_semantics.parameter: ROOM MIX / PRE DELAY / REV HI PASS / REV LOW PASS / SIZE
parameter_semantics.meaning: Built-in room reverb of the full IR Loaders; removed in Lite versions to reduce CPU.
Delays that IR by 0-25 ms.
Level change of -24..+24 dB; not the captured device's gain control. Neural DSP advises recapturing rather than boosting it; a moderator states it equals a Gain block in front of the capture.
parameter_semantics.brighter_or_more_direction: higher = hotter into the capture = more drive

parameter_semantics.meaning: Generic fixed 3-band EQ, -6..+6 dB, not the device's tonestack. Pre or post position is undocumented (users infer post); one moderator gives centres 120, 750 and 1000 Hz.
parameter_semantics.confidence: firmware range; the rest is anecdote

parameter_semantics.meaning: Output level of the capture block, -24..+24 dB.
Input Gate amount, 0-100 %, default 30; adaptive, not a threshold. Still acts at 0 % while enabled.
Input Gate bypass; default 1 = bypassed.
Per-preset, scene-assignable input trim, -24..+24 dB, default 0.
Single amount control 0-100 %, default 30; the (S/C) version adds SOURCE to key the gate from an input or earlier block.
Conventional gate: threshold -90..0 dB (default -80), attack 0.5-1000 ms (1), hold 1-2000 ms (10), release 2-5000 ms (40), range -90..-6 dB (default -90, labelled OFF).
Threshold-only gate, -90..0 dB, default -60.
Preset-level output trim per lane, -40..+12 dB, default 0; stored in the preset; scene-assignable. Feeds the output limiter.
-60..+12 dB, 0 dB at normalized 0.5; the block also has PAN and PHASE INVERT.
Global analog input gain; 0 dB = unity; display range -12..+60 dB (normalized 0.166667 = 0 dB). Changes the drive of every model.
Instrument input impedance, 10 kOhm to 10 MOhm, default 1 MOhm; global.
parameter_semantics.brighter_or_more_direction: higher = less pickup loading = brighter (general electronics)

cpu_heavy.note: Bypassing or disabling a block does not reduce CPU; only removing it does (official).
Named by the manual as the highest CPU category (official). Stereo spring reverb measured at relative weight 0.38 (one project's telemetry).
'Some devices may use more DSP than others in the same category. This is especially true with amp devices' (official). Telemetry weight 0.5-0.6, the dominant cost in most presets (anecdote).
'Capture V2 blocks use more CPU power' than V1; V1 is recommended for CPU-tight presets (official).
'IR Loader blocks use less CPU than Cab blocks' (official). Mono cab telemetry weight about 0.18 (anecdote).
Lite versions drop the room reverb 'to reduce CPU consumption' (official).
Roughly twice the mono (M) cost in telemetry (anecdote).
Different processor cores (official); each pair has its own budget, so a preset can fail at 33-48 % total when everything is on rows 1-2 (community).
Disabled automatically when a preset exceeds resources (official); tied to the rows 1-2 budget (community).
About 85 % CPU with Global EQ and Input Gate disabled (anecdote).
Lowest CPU categories per the manual (official). Drive, compressor and EQ telemetry weight 0.08-0.16 (anecdote).
Present per model (0.15-3.5) but does not track cost; not usable as a CPU estimate (firmware + inference).

rules.rule: Trim loudness with amp OUTPUT, a Gain block or lane VOLUME; never with amp MASTER.
rules.reason: MASTER is modelled power-amp gain and changes tone and feel; OUTPUT is a level after the model.

rules.rule: Treat MASTER as a tone and drive parameter in searches, alongside GAIN.
rules.reason: Manual: MASTER is 'highly interactive with all other amp parameters'; a low MASTER reduces the effect of the other controls.

rules.rule: For amps without MASTER, treat GAIN or VOLUME as whole-amp drive and re-level with OUTPUT after every change.
rules.reason: 46 models have no master; their single volume also sets power-amp drive and loudness.

rules.rule: Do not use capture GAIN as a drive control beyond a few dB; choose a different capture for more or less gain.
rules.reason: Neural DSP: recapture rather than boost the block GAIN 'for more authentic results'; the knob is level into a fixed model.

rules.rule: Use an EQ block for capture tone moves beyond small BASS/MID/TREBLE nudges.
rules.reason: The capture EQ is a generic fixed 3-band of +/-6 dB, not the device's tonestack.

rules.rule: Read the capture type before adding a cab; skip the cab for Amp + Cab, Combo Amp and Cab captures.
rules.reason: Those types already contain a speaker and microphone.

rules.rule: Check factory V2 amp captures for baked-in drive pedals before using them as a clean or crunch base.
rules.reason: Many 3.3.0 factory V2 captures are very hot and include a pedal noted only in Cortex Cloud.

rules.rule: Scale cab POSITION and DISTANCE by the declared range of the model (0-10 native, 0-1 plugin).
rules.reason: Plugin cabs declare 0-1; native-scale values would clamp.

rules.rule: Measure brightness at POSITION 0 and 10 and DISTANCE 0 and 10 once per cab before mapping 'brighter' to a direction.
rules.reason: The manual gives the meaning but not which numeric end is centre or close.

rules.rule: Skip POSITION and DISTANCE when a cab slot holds a user IR.
rules.reason: Both are disabled with external IR files.

rules.rule: Select cab mics from the list the specific cab offers; do not assume every mic exists on every cab.
rules.reason: Mic selection varies per cab (staff confirmed).

rules.rule: Prefer an IR Loader Lite over a Cab block or full IR Loader when CPU is tight and no room is needed.
rules.reason: IR Loaders cost less than Cab blocks; Lite drops the room reverb.

rules.rule: Supply user IRs as 48 kHz WAV whose useful response fits in 1024 samples (about 21 ms).
rules.reason: IRs are resized to 1024 samples; longer room IRs are truncated and lose low end.

rules.rule: Never assign a 'brief mute' switch to scenes; use two copies of the block and switch bypass instead.
rules.reason: Firmware flags 50 such parameters (see brief_mute_parameters); scene changes then lag up to about a second.

rules.rule: Address models by id, not name.
rules.reason: Legacy and updated versions share names (1109 vs 1142 D-Cell H4 Ch1 Bright, 1045 vs 1150 Solo 100 Lead).

rules.rule: Check a model's plugin_id against the user's licences before proposing it.
rules.reason: Unlicensed plugin devices are locked and cannot be loaded; a block without its licence stays silent.

rules.rule: Remove unused blocks instead of bypassing them when CPU matters.
rules.reason: Bypassed blocks still consume CPU.

rules.rule: Spread heavy blocks across rows 1-2 and rows 3-4.
rules.reason: Row pairs run on different cores with separate budgets.

rules.rule: Keep total CPU under 90 % and re-check that Input Gate and Global EQ are still active after each build.
rules.reason: Above the limit they are disabled without an error.

rules.rule: Prefer mono (M) variants and V1 captures unless stereo width or V2 dynamics are required.
rules.reason: Stereo roughly doubles cost; V2 captures use more CPU.

rules.rule: Use scenes, not preset changes, for any switch that must happen while playing.
rules.reason: Preset recall leaves a 0.2-0.4 s gap and cuts tails; scene changes are gapless.

rules.rule: After a preset recall wait at least 0.5 s, then verify by read-back, before starting a measurement.
rules.reason: Measured gaps were 0.2-0.4 s, with reports up to about 1 s.

rules.rule: Do not expect a scene to change a parameter that is assigned to an expression pedal.
rules.reason: Expression-assigned parameters are excluded from scene data.

rules.rule: Keep bypassed blocks' parameters identical across scenes unless a change is intended.
rules.reason: Large hidden parameter jumps are blamed for level spikes on scene change.

rules.rule: Leave global IN LEVEL and IMPEDANCE at 0 dB and 1 MOhm; compensate per preset with the input block INPUT GAIN.
rules.reason: I/O settings are global and shift the drive of every preset; INPUT GAIN is stored per preset and scene.

rules.rule: For high gain, place Adaptive Gate (S/C) after the amp with SOURCE = Input 1; bypass gates in clean scenes.
rules.reason: It keys from the clean input while removing amp hiss; adaptive gates chatter on decays with the guitar volume rolled back.

rules.rule: Bypass the Input Gate explicitly when another gate is used.
rules.reason: The Input Gate still acts at 0 % while enabled and interacts with other gates.

rules.rule: Measure preset loudness on grid USB outputs 5-8, not host inputs 3/4.
rules.reason: Inputs 3/4 follow the analog output stage and master volume; 5-8 are dedicated grid outputs.

rules.rule: Send reamp stimulus only to host outputs 5-8 with the grid input set to that USB input.
rules.reason: Host outputs 1-4 go straight to the analog jacks, bypassing the grid.

rules.rule: Keep true peak below about -1 dBTP at the lane output, with about 12 dB headroom for clean tones and 6 dB for distorted ones.
rules.reason: The lane output feeds the output limiter; limiting changes tone.

rules.rule: Do not equate equal LUFS with equal loudness between clean and high-gain scenes.
rules.reason: High-gain tones sound louder at the same reading, especially at stage volume.

rules.rule: Reduce each lane when summing N parallel amps (about -20*log10(N) dB as a start).
rules.reason: Parallel lanes sum and clip at unity.

rules.rule: Use TRS on outputs 3/4 or expect 6 dB less.
rules.reason: XLR 1/2 max is +9.5 dBu; 3/4 give +15.5 dBu balanced and +9.5 dBu unbalanced.

rules.rule: Treat Global EQ and I/O presets as global state: record and restore them around any test.
rules.reason: They affect every preset and are not undone by a preset reload.

rules.rule: Read UK C30/C15 TopBoost BOOST and Victor Squid FOCUS by step name, not by value.
rules.reason: Step order is [HOT, COOL] and [ON, OFF], the reverse of the usual 0 = off.
